lessons_learned: Flutter Web build staleness detected 2026-09-06: video_lesson routing fix not deployed. Rebuilt and verified deploy on Sep 9.
CRITICAL (2026-09-25): better-sqlite3 native addon compiled for wrong Node.js version caused sql.js fallback. Fixed by rebuilding with system node v24 binary directly.
Test staleness: Tests using hardcoded historical dates will fail as time passes. Always use relative or recent dates in tests.
Stale proposal files should be cleaned up promptly after their suggestions are implemented.
Backend restart required after dist rebuild — PID tracking essential to avoid dual-process conflicts.
better-sqlite3 rebuild must use SAME node binary as running backend.
CRITICAL (2026-10-05): systemd dual-process conflict — manual node process coexisted with systemd service, causing EADDRINUSE restart loops.
CRITICAL (2026-10-09): systemd dual-process conflict recurrence. Fixed by adding pre-flight check in start-lingxi.sh.
FIXED (2026-10-10): systemd dual-process conflict prevented — auto-detection added to startup scripts.
ACCIDENTAL_MERGE (2026-10-25): NestJS health module files committed to wrong directory caused TypeScript build failures. Fixed by removing misplaced files.
HTTPS API 403 from Cloudflare (2026-10-29): Cloudflare WAF may block certain API endpoints. Local API works fine.
WSL HTTPS outbound blocked: External HTTPS requests from WSL may be blocked by network configuration. Use local testing for health checks.

pi-ai package 'exports' issue (2026-10-08): @earendil-works/pi-ai v0.81.1 has no 'exports' main defined — LlmClientService falls back to plain OpenAI SDK. Non-critical: LLM functionality works via fallback path.
Build verification via Unicode escape search: dart2js escapes non-ASCII as \uXXXX — use Python unicode escape encoding to verify feature presence in compiled JS bundles.
